game_title: Iteration Tracer – Fairy Ring Glade Streak
game_concept: A card battler set in Mystic Forest – Fairy Ring Glade, a glade ringed by mushrooms: the herbalist must handle bog toads while practicing control flow: for loops. Core idea – Iteration Tracer: Predict how many times a loop body runs before the clock stops.
theme: Mystic Forest – Fairy Ring Glade: a glade ringed by mushrooms
core_gameplay_loop: In Fairy Ring Glade, repeat each round: Predict how many times a loop body runs before the clock stops. Each round poses one decision; a wrong answer breaks the streak. Then check the trace_score value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Hint tokens that reveal one line of code
player_objective: Chain 10 consecutive correct decisions about trace_score to power up the herbalist and open the fairy lantern.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
lose_condition: lives reach 0 (each wrong decision costs a life and resets the streak).
learning_alignment: Week 5 – Control Flow: For Loops | Level 3 (intro tier): Iteration Tracer
assets_style: lush pixel-art forest: dense green canopy, a glowing blue ancient tree, winding streams and dirt paths; flat Kenney-style sprites; airy flutes, birdsong and soft magical chimes

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how trace_score changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against bog toads in Fairy Ring Glade.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: streak counter reaches 10.
